purpose: Development-only controlled substitution; historical economics already viewed; no fresh holdout claim.

selection.choice: historical conditional teacher candidate, if still present under exactly the same actor-visible input

design.control: official A-prime must reproduce historical A before intervention
design.treatment: one returned selector ID substitution; original network still executes once; all later choices are dynamic

stopping_conditions: Missing or changed source, model, official engine or private input
Control fails full state/action/trace equivalence, official replay, supervision or target proof
Target input, candidate, current teacher label, original prediction or budget mismatch
Worker error, timeout, incomplete Job cleanup or failed official replay
interpretation: Single fixed case; later opponent responses and state-dependent official random draws are part of the total effect; no significance, generalization or causal decomposition.
privacy: Real seed, salt, original replay/trace, local paths and raw input hashes remain local.
source_sha_scope: Raw bytes reviewed before preparation; no OS lock against later same-user mutation.
verification_scope: Two supervised game workers with explicit NUL handles; subsequent official replays run in the parent process.
